name: homePos
meaning: = pos at Init (if in world) and on msg 9 arg 1; Reset moves the Hoover here and snaps it to the ground

name: activationBox
meaning: PROPERTY_HOOVER_ACTIVATIONBOX (Scn_GetPropBox offset 0); stored by Init and never read

name: ghosts
meaning: Ghost objects (class 120) from Scenaric_FindByClass(0x78, …, 15); receive 0x4001 and the suck request msg 0

name: battery
meaning: sender of 0x4581 (the master Battery); gets 0x4404 arg 1 at suck start and arg 0 at suck end. Uninitialised until the first 0x4581

name: inHand
meaning: 1 after a Wolf held-action query (msg 0x17); 0 after msg 7 (stored), Init, Reset. Gates arming on 0x4581

name: charged
meaning: 1 on 0x4581 (5 batteries), 0 on 0x4582; gates arming on msg 8

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: return of Wolf msg 0xE (MSG_FREEZE) when a suck starts; cleared when msg 0xF (MSG_UNFREEZE) succeeds on 0x4583

name: suckSoundHandle
meaning: Sound_Play(0x6B, vol 0x33) handle while sucking; stopped by SetState(1/2)
